elements.name: Shape Self
elements.desc: As an action, you can reshape your body to a two-legged Humanoid shape or to a four-legged Beast shape. While you have a Humanoid shape, you can wear clothing and armor made for a Humanoid of your size.

elements.name: Darkvision
elements.desc: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

elements.name: Delightful Imitator
elements.desc: You have proficiency in the Deception or Performance skill.

elements.name: Unpredictable Movement
elements.desc: When you roll Initiative, you can immediately move up to half your Speed, provided you don't have Disadvantage on the Initiative roll.

elements.name: Lorwyn Changeling
elements.desc: Fey. Small or Medium. Speed 30 ft. Traits: Shape Self, Darkvision, Delightful Imitator, Unpredictable Movement.

elements.name: Cold Fire Magic
elements.desc:
You know the Ray of Frost cantrip. When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn the Ice Knife spell and the Flame Blade spell, respectively. You always have those spells prepared. You can cast each once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast these spells in this way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. When you cast Flame Blade using this trait, the spell deals Cold damage instead of Fire damage.

Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose the ability when you select this species).

elements.name: Cold Resistance
elements.desc: You have Resistance to Cold damage.

elements.name: Darkvision (Rimekin)
elements.desc: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

elements.name: Rimekin
elements.desc: Humanoid. Small or Medium. Speed 30 ft. Traits: Cold Fire Magic, Cold Resistance, Darkvision (Rimekin).
